text.p: State-owned telecommunications group Telstra Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it would refocus its data division towards customer solutions and away from product based services and rename the division Fractal.
Telstra Retail Products group managing director Lindsay Yelland said the move acknowledged both the rapid growth in demand for data transfer.
"The data market is growing at about 20 percent and is our fastest growing market," Yellard told reporters.
Yellard said Australia's data market currently has annual revenue of about A$1.0 billion.
Telstra also launched its commercial Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) network. This network will deliver electronic mail, database and fax-from-personal computer services, Telstra said.
Yellard said its Fractal unit will offer electronic transactions, audio and video and security services.
Australia's telecommunications market is worth about A$25 billion.
